infoLinks.urlText: North Sydney bus diversions for Spring Cycle
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 12 October, buses will be diverting while roads are closed in North Sydney and the Sydney CBD for the annual Spring Cycle event.
 
From 4am to 10:30am, buses towards McMahons Point will divert around a section of Miller Street via Pacific Highway. Buses towards Riverview and Epping will divert around a section of Miller Street via Blue Street and Pacific Highway, and will make an additional stop at Greenwood Plaza, Pacific Highway, North Sydney (Stop ID 206027). Some stops on Miller Street will be missed due to road closures in North Sydney.
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Spring Cycle 2025 for more transport details.
 
Missed stops
  • Victoria Cross Station, Miller Street, Stand F, North Sydney (Stop ID 206085)
  • Victoria Cross, Miller Street, North Sydney (Stop ID 206013)
